questions.prompt: A rectangle is a parallelogram with:
choices: exactly one pair of parallel sides
questions.explanation: A rectangle inherits every parallelogram property and adds four right angles.

questions.prompt: The diagonals of a rectangle are always:
questions.explanation: Congruent diagonals are the special property of a rectangle.

questions.prompt: Do the diagonals of a rectangle bisect each other?
choices: Yes — every rectangle is a parallelogram
Only if the sides are congruent
Only if it is a rhombus
questions.explanation: A rectangle is a parallelogram, so its diagonals bisect each other as well as being congruent.

questions.prompt: In rectangle $ABCD$, $AC = 26$. What is $BD$?
questions.explanation: Diagonals of a rectangle are congruent.

questions.prompt: In rectangle $ABCD$, the diagonals meet at $M$ and $AC = 20$. Find $AM$.
questions.explanation: The diagonals bisect each other, so $AM = \tfrac{1}{2}(20) = 10$.

questions.prompt: In rectangle $ABCD$ the diagonals meet at $M$. If $AC = 16$, find $BM$.
questions.explanation: $BD = AC = 16$ and $M$ bisects it, so $BM = 8$. All four half-diagonals are equal — like four radii.

questions.prompt: Rectangle $ABCD$ has $AC = 3x + 5$ and $BD = 5x - 9$. Find $x$.
questions.explanation: The diagonals are congruent: $3x + 5 = 5x - 9 \Rightarrow 14 = 2x \Rightarrow x = 7$.

questions.prompt: With the same rectangle, how long is each diagonal?
A rectangle has sides $6$ and $8$. How long is each diagonal?
questions.explanation: A diagonal makes a right triangle: $\sqrt{6^{2}+8^{2}} = 10$.

questions.prompt: A rectangle has a diagonal of $13$ and one side of $5$. Find the other side.
A diagonal of a rectangle makes a $32^\circ$ angle with the longer side. What angle does it make with the shorter side?
questions.explanation: The two angles at a corner make up the $90^\circ$ corner: $90^\circ - 32^\circ = 58^\circ$.

questions.prompt: In rectangle $ABCD$ the diagonals meet at $M$ and $m\angle MAB = 35^\circ$. Find $m\angle AMB$.
questions.explanation: $MA = MB$, so $\triangle AMB$ is isosceles with base angles $35^\circ$; the apex is $180^\circ - 70^\circ = 110^\circ$.

questions.prompt: Which is enough to prove a parallelogram is a rectangle?
questions.explanation: Congruent diagonals in a parallelogram force four right angles. The other three are true of EVERY parallelogram.

questions.prompt: A quadrilateral has four right angles. Must it be a rectangle?
choices: No, it could be a kite
Only if the diagonals are perpendicular
Only if it is also a rhombus
questions.explanation: Four right angles is one of the standard rectangle tests.

questions.prompt: Vertices $A(0,0)$, $B(6,0)$, $C(6,3)$, $D(0,3)$ form a rectangle. What is the length of a diagonal?
How can you prove a quadrilateral on the coordinate plane is a rectangle?
choices: show it is a parallelogram and that one angle is right (slopes are negative reciprocals)
show all four sides are congruent
questions.explanation: Parallelogram + one right angle is enough; perpendicular sides show up as slopes whose product is $-1$.

questions.prompt: Every rectangle is also a:
choices: trapezoid with exactly one pair of parallel sides
questions.explanation: Rectangles are parallelograms with the extra right-angle condition.

questions.prompt: Is every parallelogram a rectangle?
choices: Only if the diagonals bisect each other
Only if it has four sides
questions.explanation: A parallelogram becomes a rectangle only when its angles are right angles.

questions.prompt: A rectangle has perimeter $34$ and one side $5$. Find the diagonal.
questions.explanation: The other side is $\tfrac{34}{2} - 5 = 12$, so the diagonal is $\sqrt{5^{2}+12^{2}} = 13$.

questions.prompt: In rectangle $ABCD$ the diagonals meet at $M$ and $m\angle AMB = 130^\circ$. Find $m\angle MBC$.
questions.explanation: $\angle BMC = 50^\circ$ (linear pair) and $\triangle BMC$ is isosceles, so its base angles are $\tfrac{180^\circ - 50^\circ}{2} = 65^\circ$.

questions.prompt: Which property does a rectangle have that a general parallelogram does NOT?
questions.explanation: Only the congruent diagonals (and the right angles) are extra.

questions.prompt: A rectangle has sides $9$ and $12$. What is the length of its diagonal?
